events.quote: The present petition challenges the impugned Show Cause Notice dated 31st May, 2024 (hereinafter ‘impugned SCN’).
A reminder notice is also stated to have been issued to the Petitioner on 10th July, 2024.
inter alia, seeking the quashing of the impugned order dated 13th August, 2024 passed by the Sales Tax Officer Class II/Avato Ward 10, Zone-2, Delhi.

defects_argued.quote: The challenge in the present petition is similar to a batch of petitions wherein inter alia, the impugned notifications were challenged.
the Petitioners have been unable to file replies due to several reasons and were unable to avail of personal hearings in most cases.
the submission of the Petitioner is that no reply has been filed by the Petitioner to the impugned SCN nor any personal hearing has been attended.

outcome.quote: Under such circumstances, considering the fact that the Petitioner did not get a proper opportunity to be heard and no reply to the SCN has been filed by the Petitioner, the matter deserves to be remanded back to the concerned Adjudicating Authority.
